print('undo OK' if g.status()['fen'] == f1 else 'STILL BUGGY')
fix(engine): undo restored the wrong position after several plies
play_uci appended the pre-move FEN, so after N plies undo jumped back
two positions instead of one (1.e4 e5 + undo returned the initial
position). Now positions[i] is the FEN after ply i, and a public
position_fens() accessor exposes them (used by the API history endpoint).
test(engine): regression tests for undo after several plies
Undo after two plies must restore the intermediate position, and
position_fens() must track the FEN after every ply.
